text:
sara (oncall): :rotating_light: Pager — multiple customers reporting console mismatch vs API for active routing flags. Paging oncall.
incident-bot: Incident created — ID INC-2101234567, severity=sev2, channels=#incidents, #eng-runtime.
mike (infra): I'm on it, pulling live deploy/flag rollout timeline. Any customer impact notes?
sara (oncall): Some customers see old routing policy in Console UI but API responses indicate new policy. Reported by 2 customers in EU region, increased error rate on routing decisions in logs.
alejandra (sre): Can we confirm whether this is control plane->dataplane propagation lag or a perf issue in the console cache?
chris (eng): Repro steps? I queried the control API and got new flag for trace-id `c4f9a2` but console snapshot still shows `route_v2=false`.
kai (runtime): Interesting — runtime nodes serve evals from local config and KVCACHE; if control-plane push failed, API could still surface config from DB while runtimes haven't refreshed. Need logs from push path.
logs-bot: Uploaded logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/INC-2101234567 (contains controlplane push, db write, and dataplane refresh traces).
mike (infra): I see the push happened at `2026-03-14T02:16:12Z` to control-plane, DB write completed `02:16:13Z`, but dataplane-refresh heartbeats show last successful refresh `02:10:00Z` for pool-eu-2.
alejandra (sre): So dataplane didn't pick up the new config. Any errors on the refresh path?
chris (eng): From controlplane logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-14T02:16:12.345Z INFO push_config id=c4f9a2 target=pools:[eu-1,eu-2]
2026-03-14T02:16:13.102Z INFO db_write id=c4f9a2 ok
2026-03-14T02:16:13.600Z WARN notify_downstream id=c4f9a2 attempt=1 err="timeout to pool-eu-2"
```
kai (runtime): That timeout to pool-eu-2 is the smoking gun. pool-eu-2 has intermittent control-plane connectivity due to a certificate rotation that started at `02:15Z`.
sara (oncall): Customers are impacted? Severity depends. Ben, any direct customer tickets?
ben (product): We're seeing 3 customer tickets now with app level routing anomalies and increased 429s. Not yet widespread but hitting top-10 accounts in EU. We should start mitigation and notify AE/SRE.
alejandra (sre): Proposed live mitigations: 1) force a synchronous refresh to pool-eu-2 from controlplane, 2) roll back flag for global until pools converge, 3) temporarily route EU region to fallback model. Which one do we do first?
mike (infra): I'll try a forced refresh (command below) to the agents on pool-eu-2: 
```
# force refresh
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/_admin/force-refresh -d '{"pool":"eu-2","id":"c4f9a2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer @infra-token'
```
chris (eng): If certificate rotation is blocking TLS, forced refresh will likely fail until certs are fixed. We should check cert-rollout status.
kai (runtime): Confirmed — agent logs show `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority` at `02:15:22Z` for pool-eu-2 during rotation. That explains the timeout.
sara (oncall): Okay prioritize cert fix + forced refresh. Mike, coordinate cert rollback/roll-forward. Alejandra, prepare rollback plan for the flag. Ben, prepare customer comms draft.
mike (infra): I'm SSHing to the control-plane cert manager now. If we can re-apply the previous cert snapshot to pool-eu-2 agents we can restore connections quickly.
logs-bot: Added timeline fragment to incident bundle: `02:10:00Z last successful refresh; 02:15:22Z cert rotation started; 02:16:12Z config push; 02:16:13Z db write; 02:16:13Z notify_downstream timeouts`
chris (eng): While infra works cert plan, I can trigger fallback routing for EU at the loadbalancer layer to reduce customer impact. That will stop new requests from hitting the inconsistent nodes.
kai (runtime): Note: fallback routing will increase latency/cost but acceptable for short window. Also prepare a job to re-run KV cache warmup once certs restored.
alejandra (sre): I'll start building the timeline for post-incident RCA here — adding hypotheses: H1=cert rotation caused agent TLS failure -> downstream refresh timeouts -> dataplane stale config; H2=controlplane notify logic bug leading to retries that masked immediate failures; H3=console UI caching bug (less likely given API shows new values).
sara (oncall): Good. Track actions in-thread: ACTION-1 mike: cert rollback/repair (in progress); ACTION-2 mike: force-refresh after cert fixed; ACTION-3 chris: enable eu fallback routing (in progress); ACTION-4 alejandra: assemble timeline and collect correlation IDs; ACTION-5 ben: customer comms draft.
mike (infra): Applied cert rollback to pool-eu-2 agents at `02:17:45Z`. Agents reconnected at `02:17:51Z`.
logs-bot: Dataplane refresh log: `2026-03-14T02:17:52.123Z INFO refresh_success pool=eu-2 id=c4f9a2 latency=320ms`
chris (eng): Forced refresh succeeded after cert restore. Console and API now consistent for sampled accounts.
bennote: ben (product): Customer comms draft: "We're investigating a transient routing config propagation issue affecting some EU customers between 02:15-02:18 UTC. We've mitigated the issue and traffic has been restored. Follow-up with RCA forthcoming."
sara (oncall): Who will own the RCA writeup? Alejandra?
alejandra (sre): I'll dogfood initial RCA and include logs, timeline, and recommended fixes: better preflight for cert rotations, add a synchronous verification step post-push, and improve notify-backoff to surface failures.
kai (runtime): Also recommend adding a metric alert for `notify_downstream` timeouts per pool so we page before customer-observed errors.
chris (eng): Agree. We should also add a sanity check in Console UI to surface when displayed config != last-known API snapshot for a tenant (helpful to catch UI cache-only issues).
sara (oncall): Final status: mitigation complete at `02:18:00Z`, customer impact window `02:15:22Z`-`02:18:00Z`. I'll update incident status and escalate to postmortem with assigned owners.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2101234567 updated: status=mitigated, severity downgraded to sev3, timeline and logs attached.
alejandra (sre): Adding post-incident tasks to the ticket: T1: add notify-timeout metric + alert, T2: cert-rotation preflight gating, T3: post-push verification job, T4: console mismatch UI indicator.
ben (product): I'll send the customer comms and follow up with affected accounts.
sara (oncall): Thanks team. We'll reconvene in the RCA doc tomorrow. Closing live thread. :thumbsup:
